extracted.intended_audience: journalism educators, college/university administrators, and facility planners at smaller institutions
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance for planning, equipping, and organizing teaching facilities (newsroom, graphics lab, editing) that support journalism, broadcasting, and speech programs, with emphasis on economy, multi-function use, and preparing students for immediate employment.

rubrics_metrics.name: Program integration (journalism, broadcasting, speech)
rubrics_metrics.description: Draw the disciplines of journalism, broadcasting, and speech into a single unit (e.g., a Center for the Study of Communications) to create cohesive training.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Purpose is 'to graduate professionals who are competent to work immediately in the mass media.' The facility planning should support interdisciplinary teaching and operations across these disciplines.

rubrics_metrics.name: Fit facilities and program to student needs
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide facilities and develop a suitable program that fit the needs of the students.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Planning must consider the curriculum and the specific educational needs of enrolled students so that the physical facilities and program offerings align with training goals and employability outcomes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Budget-conscious planning / cost-effectiveness
rubrics_metrics.description: Design facilities that are workable and economical within institutional budget constraints.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The report notes approximately $14,000 was made available as seed money; 'the planning recognizes that the problems of the new technology can be faced within a budget.' Emphasize solutions that provide necessary capability while minimizing cost, especially for smaller institutions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Dual-use newsroom design (print and broadcast)
rubrics_metrics.description: Design the newsroom to serve both print and broadcast programs.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The document states 'The newsroom was designed to be used for both the print and broadcast programs.' Facilities should support cross-medium workflows, equipment needs, and scheduling so a single newsroom can serve multiple program modalities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Multi-function facility capability
rubrics_metrics.description: Plan other facilities to serve several functions rather than single-purpose rooms.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Plans should favor rooms and labs that can be reconfigured or serve multiple instructional/production roles to increase utility and justify expense ('plans for other facilities which will serve several functions').

rubrics_metrics.name: Immediate usability with capacity for future growth
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide facilities that are ready for immediate instructional use but have capacity to expand or be upgraded later.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The planning approach recommended: 'provide facilities for immediate use with the capacity for future growth.' Design infrastructure and layouts to allow addition of new equipment, technologies, or space reconfiguration as programs expand or technology changes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Include concrete budgets and diagrams
rubrics_metrics.description: Document plans with equipment budgets and diagrams of facilities (newsroom and graphics lab).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The report 'contains a budget for equipping a newsroom and graphics laboratory and provides diagrams of these facilities.' Provide itemized equipment lists, cost estimates, and floor plans/diagrams to guide implementation and decision-making.

rubrics_metrics.name: Space utilization and facility planning efficiency
rubrics_metrics.description: Make efficient use of available space in planning teaching facilities.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Topics and summary emphasize 'Space Utilization' and 'Facility Planning.' Prioritize layouts and workflows that maximize functional capacity of limited square footage and support instructional/production activities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Focus on producing industry-ready graduates
rubrics_metrics.description: Orient facilities and program design toward preparing students for immediate employment in mass media.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Facilities and curricula should emphasize practical skills and real-work simulation so graduates are 'competent to work immediately in the mass media.' This affects equipment choices, lab setups, and instructional spaces.
